statement: Tokens and API keys declare the app they belong to (aud, one value). A host with an app serves only credentials declaring that app: another one, or none, is Rejected(APP_MISMATCH). Without a host app the credential's app applies, and a credential declaring none is in no app and reads no app document. An anonymous request has no credential, so its app is the host's. A forwarded gateway identity is the credential behind a gateway and is checked the same way. A request cannot declare an app: CoSec-App-Id is not read. A token whose aud is not one string that can be an app id is invalid, on every path that verifies one.
guards: model:ScopeResolverTest#a credential is served only by a host of its app
model:ScopeResolverTest#an anonymous subject is in the host's app and no other
model:ScopeResolverPropertyTest#the app and tenant follow the host and the credential
runtime:IdentityGateTest#an identity that names no app is refused by a host with one
cocache:StoredFormatTest#a stored api key has exactly its fields
login:SwitchTenantAuthenticationTest#the new token keeps the app of the previous one
